matrix.subject: Ownership branch separation
matrix.assessment: uid0 ancestry requirement applies only recognized mounted class; unrecognized strict branch explicitly retains account-owner allowance. Clarifies preservation without weakening recognized proof.
matrix.quote: Add one private recognized mount class: canonical immediate directories under exactly `/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Volumes`, with full basename grammar `^iOS_[0-9]{1,3}[A-Z]{1,3}[0-9]{1,6}[a-z]?$`. Names only classify a namespace; they never select, order or infer a runtime. Preserve the existing immediate-name validation for all Volumes entries. For this recognized mount class, strict ancestors from `/` through the fixed Volumes namespace must be nonsymlink directories, uid0 and not group/other writable. There is no writable-ancestor exception above these mounts. Unrecognized names keep the original strict ownership rule, including its account-owner allowance; the new uid0 requirement is not applied to their old branch.
